ownerUpdates.text:
Luxury Coffee Catering for Private Parties and Intimate Gatherings

Hosting a private party or intimate celebration in California? Kamari Coffee adds a touch of luxury with our mobile espresso bar service designed for smaller, personal gatherings. From birthday parties and baby showers to anniversary celebrations and dinner parties, we bring the same refined hospitality and handcrafted beverages that we deliver at large-scale events. Every detail from the coffee selection to the presentation is thoughtfully curated to enhance conversation, connection, and celebration among your closest guests.

How Kamari Coffee Supports Seamless Event Planning in California

At Kamari Coffee, we know that great events come down to flawless execution. That is why we make our coffee catering process as seamless as possible for event planners and hosts across California. From your initial inquiry through final service, we provide clear communication about pricing, setup requirements, guest count adjustments, and timeline coordination. Our team arrives early, sets up independently, and manages every aspect of the coffee bar so you can focus on the bigger picture of your event.

Espresso Tonic: The Refreshing Event Drink Your Guests Will Love

One of the most popular items on the Kamari Coffee menu is our espresso tonic, a bright and refreshing combination of rich espresso served over crisp tonic water. It is the perfect specialty drink for outdoor events, summer celebrations, and California gatherings where guests want something lighter and more invigorating than a traditional latte. Our baristas prepare each espresso tonic with care to achieve the ideal balance of bold coffee flavor and effervescent refreshment. Surprise your guests with this unique crowd favorite.

Coffee Flight Tasting: A Unique Experience for Your California Event

Looking for something beyond the typical coffee bar at your event? Kamari Coffee offers a curated coffee flight tasting experience that introduces guests to a range of specialty coffees in a fun, interactive format. Each flight features carefully selected brews that highlight different flavor profiles, roast levels, and preparation methods. It is a conversation starter and a memorable addition to corporate gatherings, private parties, and brand activations across California. Ask us about adding a coffee flight to your next event menu.

Planning a Conference in California? Add Mobile Espresso Service

Conferences and large corporate gatherings in California benefit greatly from dedicated mobile espresso service. Kamari Coffee sets up a fully equipped coffee bar that keeps attendees energized and engaged throughout the day. Our skilled baristas serve espresso, americanos, lattes, flat whites, and specialty beverages while maintaining efficient service flow even during peak break times. A premium coffee station shows your attendees that every detail of their experience matters. Book Kamari Coffee to make your next conference truly stand out.

Why Professional Baristas Make a Difference at Catered Events

The quality of your event's coffee service depends on the people behind the bar. At Kamari Coffee, our baristas are trained professionals who actively manage grind calibration, espresso extraction, and milk texturing throughout every event. This means drink quality stays consistent whether they are serving the first guest or the hundredth. Beyond technical skill, our baristas bring warmth, hospitality, and genuine engagement to every interaction, creating an experience that feels personal and elevated for every guest at your California event.

Signature Drink Menus: Customize Your Event's Coffee Experience

Want something unique for your California event? Kamari Coffee creates custom signature drink menus that reflect your celebration's theme, your company's brand, or your personal taste. Our baristas collaborate with you to design exclusive beverages that go beyond the standard menu, turning your coffee service into a memorable focal point. From seasonal flavor combinations to branded latte art presentations, a customized drink menu elevates your gathering from ordinary to extraordinary. Contact us to start planning your signature coffee experience.

How Much Space Does a Mobile Coffee Cart Need at Your Venue?

One of the most common questions we receive at Kamari Coffee is about space and setup requirements. We work with a variety of California venues including hotel ballrooms, outdoor gardens, office lobbies, and warehouse spaces. Before your event, we ask you to share your venue's dimensions and power availability so we can tailor our mobile coffee bar setup to fit beautifully. We typically arrive 90 minutes before service begins to ensure everything is polished, elegant, and ready to impress your guests.

Oat Milk and Dairy-Free Options Available at Every Kamari Coffee Event

At Kamari Coffee, we believe every guest deserves an exceptional coffee experience regardless of dietary preferences. That is why we offer oat milk alongside whole dairy milk at every event we cater across California. Whether your guests prefer a creamy oat milk latte, a dairy-free matcha, or a classic espresso with whole milk, our baristas prepare each drink with the same care and attention. We also accommodate custom drink requests and signature beverage menus tailored to your event needs.

Mobile Espresso Catering for Office Meetings and Team Events in California

Boost morale and productivity at your next office meeting or team event with Kamari Coffee's on-site espresso service. Our mobile coffee cart arrives fully equipped with professional baristas who prepare lattes, americanos, flat whites, and more. We tailor our setup to fit your office space and power availability, creating a welcoming coffee bar that encourages conversation and connection among colleagues. Serving companies across Northern and Southern California, Kamari makes workplace events feel special and memorable.

The Bay Area’s  Best Kept Summer Secret: Z&Y Peking Duck Cocktails 

Here at Z&Y Peking Duck, we are embracing the season’s lingering warmth with a vibrant new approach to our beverage program. Our expert mixologist, Mateo, has spent the season experimenting with premium spirits and authentic, fruit-forward Asian botanicals to craft something truly special.

“I wanted to capture the essence of a warm SF evening,” Mateo explains. “These aren’t just drinks; they are sensory escapes that perfectly complement the bold, rich flavors coming out of our kitchen.”

Whether you’re stepping off the bustling streets of Chinatown or crossing the bridge for a sophisticated night out, Mateo and our team invite you to cool down with our exclusive Soju and Zero-Proof Refreshers.

Sichuan Spice Levels Explained: How to Order Exactly What You Want in San Francisco

Chef Han’s Kitchen Journal · Z&Y Restaurant

“There’s one question I hear more than any other across this dining room: “How spicy is it, really?” I love it every time. It tells me the person wants to actually enjoy their meal — and that’s exactly the spirit Sichuan cooking is built for. Not a test of endurance, but a full sensory experience.”
— Chef Lijun Han

Here’s what you need to know before you order:

Sichuan Spice Is Two Things at Once
Most people think of spice as heat — the burn of a chili pepper. Sichuan cooking is more interesting than that. Our cuisine is built around mala (麻辣): the marriage of two distinct sensations.

The Z&Y Spice Map
Dishes marked with an asterisk (*) on our menu contain Sichuan heat and peppercorn — but not all asterisked dishes are equal. Here’s how I’d describe our range:

A quick note for first-time Sichuan diners: unlike the straightforward burn of a jalapeño or hot sauce, Sichuan heat comes with a second sensation — a gentle tingling numbness on the lips and tongue from Sichuan peppercorns, called má (麻), which softens the heat and makes bold dishes feel surprisingly approachable.

ownerUpdates.text:
Imagine waking up with clear vision without immediately reaching for your glasses or putting in contact lenses. Orthokeratology, commonly known as Ortho-K, offers a nonsurgical approach to correcting nearsightedness while you sleep. For patients in San Francisco looking for greater freedom from daytime eyewear, Ortho-K lenses may provide a convenient alternative to traditional vision correction.

 

At Eye Carumba Optometry, we understand how important clear, comfortable vision is for your daily routine. Learning how overnight vision correction works can help you determine whether Ortho-K is worth exploring.

 

How Do Ortho-K Lenses Work?
Ortho-K uses specially designed, gas-permeable contact lenses that temporarily reshape the cornea while you sleep. This gentle reshaping changes how light focuses on the retina, helping correct blurry distance vision caused by myopia.

 

Unlike traditional contact lenses, which correct vision while worn, Ortho-K lenses are removed in the morning. The temporary corneal changes allow many patients to see clearly throughout the day without glasses or daytime contacts.

 

Although some patients achieve 20/20 vision, results vary based on prescription, corneal characteristics, and consistency of wear. The effects are reversible, meaning vision gradually returns toward its original prescription when treatment is discontinued.

Driving through San Francisco can become noticeably more difficult when fall fog, drizzle, wet pavement, and early sunsets arrive at the same time. Headlights may look smeared, streetlights can develop halos, and reflections from wet roads can make signs and lane markings harder to distinguish.
 

At Eye Carumba Optometry, we help San Francisco drivers determine whether glare is simply environmental or whether an outdated prescription, astigmatism, dry eye, or the wrong lens design is making nighttime vision more difficult.
 

Why Does Fog Make Driving Vision Harder?
 
Fog contains tiny water droplets that scatter light. Instead of headlights and streetlights appearing as sharp points, their light spreads across your field of vision.
 

This reduces contrast, making pedestrians, road markings, cyclists, and other vehicles more difficult to distinguish from the background.
 

Rain adds another challenge. Water on the pavement reflects headlights, traffic signals, and storefront lighting toward your eyes. In busy parts of San Francisco, multiple reflected light sources can quickly create visual clutter.
 

Why Do Headlights Look Blurry or Streaky?
 
If lights appear stretched, starburst-shaped, or surrounded by halos, your prescription may be part of the problem.
 

Common contributors include:
 

Uncorrected or changing astigmatism

An outdated glasses prescription

Scratched or smudged lenses

Reflections from lenses without anti-reflective coating

For many San Francisco professionals, spending most of the workday in front of a laptop, monitor, or smartphone is unavoidable. Whether you are coding, attending video meetings, analyzing data, or switching between multiple screens, prolonged digital device use can leave your eyes feeling tired and uncomfortable.
 

Computer vision syndrome, also called digital eye strain, describes the group of symptoms associated with extended screen use. At Eye Carumba Optometry, we help San Francisco patients identify what is contributing to their discomfort and find practical ways to make screen-heavy workdays easier on their eyes.
 

Recognize the Signs of Computer Vision Syndrome
Screen fatigue can affect more than just how tired your eyes feel. Common symptoms include:

Dry, burning, or irritated eyes
Blurry or fluctuating vision
Headaches after prolonged computer use
Difficulty refocusing from near to far
Eye fatigue late in the workday
Neck or shoulder discomfort associated with screen positioning
 
Symptoms may become more noticeable after several uninterrupted hours of computer work. An outdated prescription, dry eye, glare, poor screen positioning, or an underlying focusing issue can also make digital eye strain worse.

San Francisco may be known for foggy mornings, cooler temperatures, and rapidly changing weather, but UV exposure does not disappear when summer ends. Ultraviolet rays can reach your eyes throughout the year, including on cloudy or overcast days. At Eye Carumba Optometry, we encourage patients to think about UV protection as part of their everyday eye health routine, not simply something to consider during warm summer months.

How UV Rays Can Affect Your Eyes
The sun produces ultraviolet radiation that can affect both the skin and the eyes. Short periods of intense UV exposure may irritate or damage the surface of the eye, while repeated exposure over many years can contribute to certain eye conditions.

Long-term UV exposure has been associated with an increased risk of cataracts and pterygium, which is a growth that can develop on the white portion of the eye. Excessive UV exposure can also cause photokeratitis, sometimes described as a sunburn of the eye.

Because these effects can accumulate over time, protecting your eyes consistently is important at every age.

Why San Francisco Weather Can Be Misleading
It is easy to assume sunglasses are unnecessary when San Francisco skies are cloudy or temperatures are cool. However, clouds do not completely block ultraviolet radiation. UV exposure can still occur while walking through the Financial District, spending time near the waterfront, commuting, or enjoying outdoor activities around the Bay Area.

San Francisco weather can change quickly. A cool, foggy morning may turn into a sunny afternoon, while wind can pick up at almost any time of day. For people with dry eye, these changing conditions can make symptoms more noticeable.

Dry eye occurs when the eyes do not produce enough quality tears or when tears evaporate too quickly. Wind, low humidity, sun exposure, and time spent in climate-controlled indoor spaces can all affect the tear film. That means a routine commute, lunch outside, or afternoon walk through San Francisco may leave your eyes feeling irritated even if they felt comfortable earlier in the day.

Fog and Wind Can Increase Tear Evaporation
Fog may make the air feel damp, but San Francisco’s coastal winds can still contribute to dry eye symptoms. Moving air across the surface of the eyes can cause tears to evaporate faster, especially for people who already have an unstable tear film.

You may notice discomfort while walking near the Embarcadero, waiting for public transportation, biking, or spending time outdoors on breezy days. Contact lens wearers may be especially aware of dryness when environmental conditions change throughout the day.

Bright Afternoons Can Add Another Layer of Irritation
When the fog clears, brighter sunlight and glare may make already irritated eyes feel more sensitive. Squinting and exposure to outdoor air can add to discomfort, while moving between sunny streets and air-conditioned offices creates another environmental shift.

Back-to-school season means more reading, homework, tablets, laptops, and classroom screens. While technology is an important part of learning, long periods of near work can leave children dealing with tired eyes, headaches, dryness, or blurry vision. At Eye Carumba Optometry in San Francisco, we provide pediatric eye examinations for children ages four and older to help identify vision concerns that could make classroom activities more difficult.
 

What Is Digital Eye Strain?
 
Digital eye strain, also called computer vision syndrome, refers to eye and vision symptoms associated with prolonged use of computers, tablets, phones, and other digital devices. Children may experience dry or itchy eyes, blurry vision, headaches, or general eye discomfort after extended screen use. These symptoms are usually temporary, but they can make visually demanding activities less comfortable.
 

With San Francisco students frequently moving between classroom screens, homework assignments, and personal devices, recognizing these symptoms can help parents determine when an eye exam is appropriate.

Neck stiffness and shoulder discomfort are often blamed on long hours at a desk. However, eyewear can also influence posture. When progressive lenses do not align properly with a person’s visual needs, they may tilt their head, raise their chin, or lean toward a screen to find a clearer viewing area.

High-precision progressive lenses provide a more personalized visual experience. With accurate measurements, appropriate lens design, and a properly fitted frame, wearers can move more naturally between distance, intermediate, and near vision.

How Progressive Lenses Can Affect Posture
Progressive lenses contain multiple prescription zones within one seamless lens. The upper area supports distance vision, the middle provides intermediate vision, and the lower portion is used for reading and close work.

When the intermediate zone is too narrow or improperly positioned, a wearer may lift their chin to view a computer screen clearly. If the reading area is difficult to locate, they may lower or extend their neck while using a phone or reviewing documents. Repeating these movements throughout the day can contribute to posture strain.

Computer vision syndrome, also called digital eye strain, describes a group of vision and comfort problems linked to prolonged computer, tablet, and phone use. It often develops gradually during the workday. Your vision may feel clear in the morning, then become blurry, tired, or difficult to maintain by late afternoon.
The issue is not usually the screen alone. Desk work requires your eyes to focus at a fixed distance for long periods while coordinating eye movement, blinking, and close-up concentration. When these systems remain under constant demand without enough recovery, symptoms become more noticeable.

Computer-based work often means moving between multiple monitors, video calls, overhead lighting, and mobile devices throughout the day. Even with an accurate prescription, reflections, screen brightness, reduced blinking, and prolonged near focus can leave your eyes feeling tired or uncomfortable.

San Francisco commuters are used to chilly mornings, coastal fog, wind tunnels between downtown buildings, and long hours on screens. What many people do not realize is how much these daily conditions can affect the eyes. At Eye Carumba Optometry, we help patients understand what is causing their dry eye symptoms and how to manage them with care that fits their lifestyle.

Summer Entertaining in Chinatown: Where to Park, Explore, and Celebrate

CHEF HAN’S KITCHEN JOURNAL • Z&Y PEKING DUCK

An insider’s guide to San Francisco’s most storied neighborhood — the parking garages locals swear by, the hidden corners most visitors walk right past, and why a whole-roasted Peking duck might just be the best way to mark any milestone this summer.
By Chef Lijun Han, Owner & Head Chef, Z&Y Peking Duck

Every summer, I watch San Francisco come alive in a way that reminds me why I chose this city — and this neighborhood — more than two decades ago. The fog lifts a little earlier. The streets fill a little faster. And the families who walk through our doors on a warm Friday evening have that unmistakable look of people who have come here to celebrate something.

Chinatown is not just where I cook. It is the oldest Chinatown in North America, a neighborhood of layered histories, living traditions, and — I say this without bias — some of the most memorable food in the Bay Area. But I also know that getting here, navigating parking, deciding what to see before dinner: these things can feel complicated if you don’t know where to look.

Consider this your guide. I have written it for the family driving in from the suburbs, for the Bay Area local who hasn’t visited in years, and for anyone planning a summer gathering they want to remember.

How to Order Like a San Francisco Local This Summer: Start with These Refreshing Sichuan Cold Dishes in Chinatown 

CHEF HAN’S KITCHEN JOURNAL • Z&Y PEKING DUCK

By Chef Lijun Han, Owner & Head Chef, Z&Y Peking Duck

Walking through San Francisco’s Chinatown on a warm summer afternoon? The city’s famous fog occasionally retreats, leaving Grant Avenue bathed in rare, golden heat. After a morning spent exploring the bustling streets of North Beach, hunting for
treasures near Union Square, or navigating the vibrant alleys of Chinatown, there is a good meal waiting for you.

As the Executive Chef, I have spent years observing the rhythm of our dining room. On these sun-drenched San Francisco days, I watch our guests come in from the heat. Before you even contemplate our signature Peking duck or our fiery main courses, there is no better way to start your meal than with a few of our Sichuan cold dishes.

In Sichuan culinary philosophy, liang ban (cold tossed) dishes are far more than mere appetizers. They are a proper start to the meal. Light, nuanced, and packed with bold, aromatic complexity, these dishes balance cooling textures with deeply savory flavor.

Sichuan Spice Levels Explained: How to Order Exactly What You Want in San Francisco

Chef Han’s Kitchen Journal · Z&Y Restaurant

“There’s one question I hear more than any other across this dining room: “How spicy is it, really?” I love it every time. It tells me the person wants to actually enjoy their meal — and that’s exactly the spirit Sichuan cooking is built for. Not a test of endurance, but a full sensory experience.”
— Chef Lijun Han

Here’s what you need to know before you order:

Sichuan Spice Is Two Things at Once
Most people think of spice as heat — the burn of a chili pepper. Sichuan cooking is more interesting than that. Our cuisine is built around mala (麻辣): the marriage of two distinct sensations.

The Z&Y Spice Map
Dishes marked with an asterisk (*) on our menu contain Sichuan heat and peppercorn — but not all asterisked dishes are equal. Here’s how I’d describe our range:

A quick note for first-time Sichuan diners: unlike the straightforward burn of a jalapeño or hot sauce, Sichuan heat comes with a second sensation — a gentle tingling numbness on the lips and tongue from Sichuan peppercorns, called má (麻), which softens the heat and makes bold dishes feel surprisingly approachable.

To learn more about Mala, and spicy levels, reserve a seat to enjoy the experience of a traditional Sichuan meal. Feel free to follow the link below for more.

Experience the artistry of tradition! 🍵✨

We are thrilled to invite you to a captivating Kung Fu Tea performance at our Peking Duck location. Watch as our masters blend martial arts precision with the delicate grace of tea pouring—a spectacle that is as much about the skill as it is about the flavor.

🕒 Performance Schedule
Join us every week Monday, Thursday, and Saturday! 

🦆 The Perfect Pairing
Why settle for just a meal when you can have an experience? Pair the rhythmic flow of our tea ceremony with our signature crisp, authentic Peking Duck for the ultimate evening out. It’s a feast for both the eyes and the palate.

Don't miss out—see you this week for tea and duck!

Mother’s Day is Almost Fully Booked 🌸 Reserve Now!

A special Mother’s Day menu made just for her

Dear friends,

Mother’s Day has always felt like one of the most meaningful meals of the year - not simply because of the date on the calendar, but because of what it invites us to do: gather, slow down, and honor someone who is so often the one caring for everyone else.

In my own family, that sense of care has always been expressed through food, in the time taken to prepare it, in the thought behind each dish, and in the joy of sharing it together. It’s a language of gratitude that doesn’t need many words.

This May, we’ve created two special set menus for Mother’s Day, designed for that kind of table. Each dish is chosen with intention - balancing refinement and comfort, familiarity and surprise. From our Caviar Peking Duck to hand-pulled Beijing Dalu Noodles, these menus represent the best of what this kitchen can offer and the kind of meal meant to be shared with the people who matter most.

I would be honored to cook for your mother this spring. Reservations are limited - I hope you'll secure yours early.

“Every dish on these menus carries something I care about deeply — the Caviar Peking Duck represents a twenty-year promise I made to this city, and the Dalu Noodles are a dish my own mother loved. This Mother's Day, I cook with both of them in mind.”
— Chef Lijun Han

ownerUpdates.text:
A big weekend for San Francisco calls for a memorable brunch. This Saturday, October 17, join us at MKT Restaurant & Bar at Four Seasons Hotel San Francisco to watch our hometown team compete in the women’s basketball finals at Chase Center. Catch the game live at 12:30 PM while enjoying a leisurely weekend brunch in the heart of downtown.

Discover Chef Acosta’s signature Crème Brûlée French Toast, alongside brunch favorites such as avocado toast, egg white frittata and freshly pressed juices. Be sure to enjoy a slice of our much-loved banana bread as you settle in for the game.

With panoramic views of Market Street, thoughtfully prepared dishes and a lively atmosphere, MKT is the perfect place to gather with friends, savor the morning and cheer on our home team.

Make a reservation at MKT Restaurant & Bar and join us for a Saturday of exceptional brunch and basketball.

Sometimes the best way to experience San Francisco is from the comfort of your room. At Four Seasons Hotel San Francisco, In-Room Dining is available 24 hours a day, with a hot menu available around the clock for those moments when you’d rather stay in.

Start the morning with breakfast and coffee delivered to your door, order a leisurely lunch between plans, or settle in for dinner after a day exploring the city. Our menu brings the flavors of MKT and San Francisco to your room, with thoughtful service at every step.

And don’t forget something sweet. Our freshly baked banana bread has become a guest favorite, perfect alongside your morning coffee, while our rich chocolate cake is an indulgent way to end the evening.

Whether you’re enjoying a quiet morning, taking a break from the city or winding down for the night, In-Room Dining makes it easy to settle in and stay awhile.

As the sun sets over San Francisco, MKT takes on a new energy.

Five floors above Market Street, floor-to-ceiling windows frame the city as it begins to glow, creating an inviting backdrop for evening cocktails, dinner and time well spent. Settle into the bar for a cocktail inspired by one of San Francisco's iconic neighborhoods, share a few bites or linger over a seasonal California-inspired dinner.

With panoramic views and a lively yet intimate atmosphere, MKT is a destination for evenings that don't need to end early.

Gather your favorite people and make San Francisco your next girls' getaway.

Set in the heart of downtown, Four Seasons Hotel San Francisco puts you close to everything you want to do together—from shopping around Union Square, riding the iconic cable cars and enjoying a picnic at the Painted Ladies.

Spend the day exploring, then return to spacious accommodations to get ready for an evening at MKT Restaurant & Bar. Make time for cocktails, weekend brunch or a little wellness at Equinox Sports Club, all under one roof.

For an extra-special escape, let our Concierge team arrange a private city tour, a sailing experience on the Bay or another personalized adventure tailored to your group.

Before Market Street became the bustling heart of downtown San Francisco, it was home to the city's thriving newspaper and printing industry.

MKT Restaurant & Bar pays homage to that storied chapter of San Francisco history, bringing the spirit of the city's printing era into a modern dining experience. Warm wood tones, brass accents and thoughtful design details echo the character of Market Street's past, while floor-to-ceiling windows offer a distinctly present-day view of the city below.

Set five floors above Market Street, MKT brings together California-inspired cuisine, craft cocktails and panoramic city views in a space where San Francisco's history meets its modern energy.

Come for the view. Stay for the story.

Meet the chef behind MKT Restaurant & Bar.

A Northern California native with more than 20 years of Four Seasons experience, Executive Chef Shaun Acosta brings his culinary journey home to San Francisco. His approach is rooted in a simple philosophy: let quality ingredients speak for themselves.

At MKT, Chef Shaun blends simplicity and innovation with a deep appreciation for the season and the region, creating California-inspired cuisine that celebrates the abundance of Northern California.

From locally sourced ingredients to thoughtfully crafted seasonal dishes, every plate reflects his connection to the Bay Area and his passion for creating food that feels both refined and approachable.

Join us at MKT Restaurant & Bar and experience Chef Shaun's take on modern California cuisine, served with panoramic views of downtown San Francisco.

Make your next business lunch a little more memorable.

Located in the heart of downtown San Francisco, MKT Restaurant & Bar offers an elevated setting for client lunches, team gatherings and business meetings. Enjoy thoughtful cuisine, attentive service and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the city — all while staying close to the offices, attractions and meeting destinations that bring you downtown.

Whether you're closing a deal or catching up with a colleague, let MKT take care of the details.

MKT's weekend brunch brings together some seriously tempting creations, including our Crème Brûlée French Toast, Ube Ricotta Donuts, Crispy Chicken & Waffle Sandwich, Loaded Omelet and San Francisco Brunch Louie.

Whether your brunch style leans sweet, savory or somewhere in between, there's something for everyone.

Gather your favorite people and make your next weekend brunch a little more delicious at MKT Restaurant & Bar.

San Francisco has neighborhoods with personalities all their own. Our newest cocktail menu at MKT pays tribute to them, one pour at a time.

Inspired by the character, culture and energy of San Francisco's distinctive neighborhoods, each cocktail offers a different way to experience the city—from the familiar to the unexpected.

Settle into MKT Restaurant & Bar, take in panoramic city views through our floor-to-ceiling windows and explore an ode to the city we call home.

One city. Countless neighborhoods. A cocktail menu worth exploring."

Sometimes the best table in San Francisco is the one in your room.

With 24-hour In-Room Dining at Four Seasons Hotel San Francisco, you can enjoy something delicious whenever the craving strikes—breakfast before an early morning, a late-night bite after exploring the city or a sweet ending to the evening.

And when it comes to dessert, our chocolate cake deserves a moment of its own: rich, decadent and made for enjoying from the comfort of your room.

Because luxury means having exactly what you want, whenever you want it. We couldn't agree more.
